results.detalle: Weighted average interest rate by amounts traded, corresponding to wholesale fixed-term deposits in pesos, with a term of 30 to 35 days, constituted in all private banks. In 2025 it covered operations of 1 billion pesos and more. Starting in 2026, once a year, the amount stratum of the operations included is updated, according to the variation of the Consumer Price Index. The methodological details can be viewed at the following link: https://www.bcra.gob.ar/archivos/pdfs/PublicacionesEstadisticas/ratesmeth.pdf
